title: withdrawAll escape hatch omits promoToken sweep (completeness gap)
description: migrate reads promoToken from PhlimboV3 (L149) and forwards promo rewards to migrated users (L182-193), so promoToken balances can transit the migrator. The owner withdrawAll escape hatch (L216-228) sweeps only phUSD (L221-222) and rewardToken (L224-225), not promoToken.
impact: No user-fund risk in normal migration flow — completeness gap in the recovery path. Stranded promo tokens would need a separate ad-hoc recovery mechanism.
recommendation: Extend withdrawAll to also sweep promoToken when set, mirroring the per-token handling already present in migrate.
